verdict.rationale: Kick documents an MCP server, a CLI, and an MCP available-tools page, but nothing in the pack shows an interactive API reference with runnable examples. Probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs all returned 404. The llms.txt index and the GitBook 'ask' query interface are features of the GitBook host platform, not a Kick API reference, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
